services.name: School Programs
services.desc: Our Nature Centres offer hands-on, curriculum-based outdoor education classes for students in Kindergarten through high school, including the Specialist High Skills Major programs. Programs can be either full-day or half-day. Our staff are trained nature interpreters with a passion for kids and environmental education. As per the GRCA Fee Policy (196 KB PDF), please see Fee Schedule 1 Outdoor Environmental Education Programs and Services (627 KB PDF) for a list of our current fees. Please see our list of school programs (301 KB PDF) for descriptions, duration, locations offered and curriculum
